operatingConditions.screenState: operator-confirmed ready; runner does not wake, unlock, rotate, or change display settings

measurementScope.latency: synthetic dispatch-to-frame-start latency; benchmark instrumentation uses intrusive glFinish
measurementScope.fade: observedIdleAfterUpMs is a polling upper bound, not an exact fade-commit timestamp
measurementScope.processes: each launch is force-stopped before launch; run 1 is process-cold and run 2 is same-process warm
